uncited: It builds on [Round-robin Leaf Assignment](12287-round-robin-leaf-assignment.md) by providing the underlying hierarchical data structure and reduction logic that precedes the distribution strategy.
*   **Interoctant Links:** Links between parent and child nodes, and between sibling nodes.
*   **Local Root Structure:** Off-processor parent links are represented by a local root structure containing spatial information.
**Insertion:** Loop through the input field data.
*   **User-defined maximum number of elements per octant:** The threshold for subdividing an octant leaf.
*   **Uniform/P-adaptive Meshes:** The max-element criterion is insufficient for uniform meshes or p-adaptive methods.

*   **Complex Algorithms:** Complex algorithms operating on the reduced data set (such as streamlines or isosurface generation) may require fat-neighbor links or a guarantee of maximum level-difference between adjacent octants.
